privileged_info_for_vlm: The target theme is 'magazine-child'. The reading time must be calculated at 200 words per minute, rounded up (e.g., 450 words = 3 min). The specific disclaimer text required for the 'health' category is: 'Disclaimer: This content is for informational purposes only and not substitute for professional medical advice.' Both injections must use specific HTML classes: 'reading-time' and 'health-disclaimer'.
